xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3021: Composer slash-command autocomplete is a hand-maintained list drifted 38 commands behind the CLI (strike, swarm, task, approve, merge, flywheel…)

plan.title: Generate composer slash-command autocomplete from the CLI command registry
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: SLASH_COMMANDS in src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/ComposerPromptEditor.tsx:65-211 is a hardcoded, hand-maintained array that has drifted 38 top-level commands behind the pan CLI (strike, swarm, task, approve, merge, flywheel, pause, release, …) and also lists commands whose CLI shape no longer exists. Operators typing a real verb get no autocomplete match and doubt the verb exists.
narratives.Proposal: Generate the pan-command entries from the CLI's own commander registry: a new plumbing subcommand `pan admin commands --json` (pure walker collectCommandTree over visibleCommands) feeds scripts/generate-slash-commands.mjs, which applies an explicit curation overlay (deny/categories/extras) and writes a committed slashCommands.generated.ts. The composer merges that with a small static list (/model, /context, /effort, /cancel, /handoff). A drift lint (scripts/lint-slash-commands.sh, wired into npm run lint after lint:skills) regenerates and fails CI on any diff — the same mechanical pattern as scripts/lint-skills.sh. A no-loss test pins the entire pre-change surface. Full PRD: .pan/drafts/PAN-3021.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No runtime endpoint serving commands (/api/slash-commands); build-time generation only
- No generated per-flag/option entries; flag variants remain curated extras
- No change to menu UX (filtering, grouping, highlighting, keyboard nav, insert semantics)
- No populated deny list in this issue — it ships empty; hiding plumbing is a later explicit curation decision
- No changes to skills tooling, scripts/lint-skills.sh, or the t3code composer redesign

autoDecisions.summary: Build-time generation into a committed file with a drift lint, instead of a runtime endpoint backed by the registry.
autoDecisions.rationale: The CLI entrypoint has load-time side effects and cannot be imported by the dashboard server; the repo already enforces exactly this pattern for skills via scripts/lint-skills.sh running the locally built CLI; a committed file keeps the frontend build decoupled.

autoDecisions.summary: Introspection implemented as a CLI plumbing subcommand (pan admin commands --json) rather than a separate program-construction script.
autoDecisions.rationale: Running inside the CLI guarantees the emitted tree is byte-for-byte the registry the shipped binary parses — no second construction path that could itself drift.

autoDecisions.summary: deny list ships empty; every visible command appears in the menu.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue states curation must be an explicit act over the generated set; defaulting to full visibility is the smallest defensible choice and hidden:true commands are already excluded by commander.

autoDecisions.summary: Old flag-variant entries (pan show --cv, pan fork --plain, pan handoff --model/--harness/--cwd, pan plan --auto --auto-start, pan review reset --session, pan show --context, pan show --health) are preserved as curated extras.
autoDecisions.rationale: Generating option permutations explodes the menu; the no-loss rule requires these existing affordances to survive, and extras are additive curation, not an independent copy.

items.title: Add collectCommandTree walker and `pan admin commands --json` plumbing subcommand

verify_commands: node dist/cli/index.js admin commands --json | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const t=JSON.parse(d);const paths=t.map(c=>c.path.join(' '));for(const p of ['strike','swarm','admin cloister status']){if(!paths.includes(p)){console.error('missing '+p);process.exit(1)}}if(paths.includes('review spawn-reviewer')){console.error('hidden leaked');process.exit(1)}console.log('ok '+t.length+' commands')})"
expected_outputs: introspection smoke prints 'ok <n> commands' with strike/swarm/admin cloister status present and no hidden review spawn-reviewer entry

narrative.Action: Create src/cli/command-introspection.ts exporting CommandInfo {path, description, args, hasSubcommands} and collectCommandTree(root: Command): CommandInfo[] — depth-first walk in registration order using root.createHelp().visibleCommands(cmd) (public commander API; never the private _hidden field), skipping the implicit 'help' command, reading positional args from cmd.registeredArguments (name/required/variadic). In registerAdminCommands (src/cli/commands/admin/index.ts:25, which already receives the root program) register `commands` with --json: JSON mode prints JSON.stringify(tree, null, 2); human mode prints one 'pan <path>  —  <description>' line per entry. Unit-test the walker against a synthetic commander program containing nested groups, a {hidden:true} command, and an <id> argument. Exact interface and snippets: PRD W1 in .pan/drafts/PAN-3021.md.

items.title: Given the built CLI, `pan admin commands --json` emits a JSON array containing paths ['strike'], ['swarm'] and ['admin','cloister','status'], each with a non-empty description
Given the built CLI, the --json output contains no hidden command entry (no ['review','spawn-reviewer']) and no implicit 'help' entry at any depth
collectCommandTree returns args metadata: for a synthetic command 'kill <id>' the unit test asserts it produces {name:'id', required:true, variadic:false}
The unit test on a synthetic program with a {hidden:true} subcommand asserts the walker emits exactly the visible paths in registration order
Generator script + curation overlay producing committed slashCommands.generated.ts

expected_outputs: diff between two consecutive generator runs is empty (byte-identical output)

narrative.Action: Create slashCommandTypes.ts holding the SlashCommand interface (moved verbatim from ComposerPromptEditor.tsx:57-63; no imports). Create scripts/slash-commands-curation.json with deny: [] (ships empty), categories map (top-level verb → menu section, PRD W2 lists the full initial map; unmapped verbs default to 'CLI'), and extras: the nine flag-variant entries copied verbatim from the old list. Create scripts/generate-slash-commands.mjs: fail fast if dist/cli/index.js missing (message names npm run build:cli); spawnSync the CLI's `admin commands --json`; include leaves at any depth plus non-leaf commands with positional args (covers `pan plan [id]`; pure groups like review/workspace/admin/backup are excluded); apply deny prefixes; map to {id:'pan-'+path.join('-'), label:'pan '+path.join(' '), insert: label + (args.length? ' ' : ''), description: first sentence hard-capped at 100 chars with ellipsis, category from overlay}; append extras; support --out <path>; write the GENERATED-header file importing type SlashCommand from './slashCommandTypes'. Add package.json script generate:slash-commands. Commit the generated file; if scripts/lint-file-size.sh flags it, baseline it in scripts/file-size-baseline.txt in this same commit. Exact output template: PRD W2.

expected_outputs: lint:slash-commands exits 0 on a freshly generated file

narrative.Action: Create scripts/lint-slash-commands.sh: exit 2 with a 'run npm run build:cli first' message if dist/cli/index.js is absent; run node scripts/generate-slash-commands.mjs --out <tempfile>; diff -u against the committed src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/slashCommands.generated.ts; on mismatch print "slash-command autocomplete has drifted from the CLI registry — run 'npm run generate:slash-commands' and commit the result" and exit 1. Add package.json script lint:slash-commands and insert 'npm run lint:slash-commands' into the root lint chain immediately after 'npm run lint:skills' (whose prelint already builds the CLI, so the chain never hits the missing-dist path).

items.title: With a freshly regenerated committed file, npm run lint:slash-commands exits 0
With the generated file hand-modified, npm run lint:slash-commands exits non-zero and its output names npm run generate:slash-commands as the fix
The root package.json lint script contains 'npm run lint:slash-commands' immediately after 'npm run lint:skills', so npm run lint runs the drift gate
No-loss audit test pinning the entire pre-change autocomplete surface

expected_outputs: slashCommands.no-loss.test.ts passes, covering all pre-change entries either as survivors or verified deliberate removals

narrative.Action: Create the no-loss audit test per .claude/rules/additive-refactor-no-loss.md. Embed as data the complete pre-change SLASH_COMMANDS surface — every {label, insert} pair from ComposerPromptEditor.tsx:65-211 at commit acdd72d806 (use `git show acdd72d806:src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/ComposerPromptEditor.tsx` to copy it exactly). Embed DELIBERATE_REMOVALS [{label, reason}] filled by checking each old entry against live `pan admin commands --json` output; only entries whose CLI path no longer exists may be listed (planning found candidates: pan admin tasks compact, pan admin tasks stats — verify every entry mechanically, entry by entry). Assert: (1) each old entry not in removals has an exact-insert match in the new merged SLASH_COMMANDS; (2) no removals entry has a match (guards against parking live commands there); (3) /model, /context, /effort, /cancel, /handoff are present verbatim; (4) labels 'pan strike', 'pan swarm', 'pan pause' exist and at least one label each starts with 'pan flywheel ', 'pan merge ', 'pan task ', 'pan release '.

items.title: The test enumerates every pre-change entry and fails when any survivor's exact insert text is removed from the merged SLASH_COMMANDS (demonstrated during development by temporarily deleting one extras entry)
The test fails if a DELIBERATE_REMOVALS entry's insert text actually exists in the merged list, preventing live commands from being parked as removals

The test fails when the merged SLASH_COMMANDS is missing any of the five static entries or the issue-headline commands (pan strike, pan swarm, pan pause, plus flywheel/merge/task/release leaves), and passes when all are present
